hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none

rules: NEVER use generic sans for headings (No Inter/Roboto).
Use extremely tight letter spacing on large headings.
Oversized quotes should feature 'Playfair Display' italic for an editorial feel.
Headings should use font-light or font-medium, avoiding overly heavy bold weights for elegance.
Base background is always warm linen (#F9F6F0). Do not use stark #FFFFFF except for specific floating content cards.
Apply the 'Tinted Grey' rule: never use pure black or grey.
Hover states for CTAs must visually match the sub-brand primary color.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity-20, mix-blend-multiply) across the entire site to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Clipped frames for imagery—use tall arches, pill shapes, or sharp aspect ratios (e.g., 3:4 or 16:9). No default square corners.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must use directional gradients (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent) rather than flat blankets.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-8, p-12, p-24. Double the standard padding.

master_hub.hero: Kinetic typography text-reveal hero. Left aligned massive text, right aligned spotlight cut-out photo of Susan. Background features subtle parallax.
master_hub.router_section: The Crossroads: 3 massive vertical bento-style cards taking up full screen width combined on desktop (grid-cols-3). Hover expands the width slightly. Each card is tinted with its respective sub-brand color.
master_hub.about: Large elegant quote with oversized quotation marks. 'Bridging health, wealth, and leadership.'

nourish_and_thrive.hero: Split screen (Swiss grid). Left text, right clipped frame (arch shape). Sage green accents.
nourish_and_thrive.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon with health specialties (Gut Health • Hormonal Balance • Mindful Nutrition) using Playfair Display.
nourish_and_thrive.content: Bento grid (Mode A: Tetris) detailing coaching packages and supplementation advice. High negative space.

women_prosper.hero: Overlapping images of women collaborating. Kinetic bold typography. Amber accents.
women_prosper.manifesto: Numbered manifesto chapters (1. Wealth is Wellness. 2. Community over Competition.) styled with massive numbers.
women_prosper.content: Asymmetrical grid for testimonials and mentorship programs.

speaking_workshops.hero: Full-screen image of speaker on stage with a heavy glassmorphic overlay box containing the value proposition. Executive Navy accents.
speaking_workshops.content: High-density data grid (Mode B) for workshop topics and outcomes.
speaking_workshops.booking_form: Shadcn-based dedicated booking/inquiry form (org name, event date, audience size). Sharp 2px corner radius.

animations.hero_kinetic: Masked line-by-line reveal on load using framer-motion (y: '100%' to '0%' inside an overflow-hidden wrapper).
animations.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero images and background shapes using framer-motion useScroll.
animations.hover_states: Micro-interactions on all links/buttons (scale: 1.05, bg transition).

reusable.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for Master/Health/Women, Sharp edges (rounded-sm) for B2B/Speaking. Must include hover micro-animations.
reusable.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and B2B floating overlays (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70, 1px border-white/20).
reusable.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, DatePicker. Customize Shadcn default to remove Vercel-look. Apply sub-brand accent color to focus rings.

images.description: Confident black woman in orange blazer. Cut out the background for spotlight effect.
Woman with healthy food assortment, promoting fitness and nutrition.
Diverse group of women in a collaborative business meeting.
Speaker presenting at a tech conference.

3d_libraries.parallax_moment: Use Framer Motion 3D or react-spring-parallax for a subtle 2.5D layer effect on the Master Hub hero image and 'router' crossroads section.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards, especially over imagery. Use text-shadow if needed.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8 to p-24) to create a premium, editorial feel.
Implement glassmorphism with high blur (12-24px) for sticky headers.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Do not center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }` is strictly forbidden).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, entrance reveals).
Include subtle grain textures/noise overlays via CSS/SVG to elevate the design.
Only use provided images. DO NOT use placeholder text or mock URLs.
Install and use `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react` for elegant, thin-weight icons.
